jsonLd.description:
Take in Vancouver's biggest event, FIFA World Cup this summer.

Exquisitely furnished executive 1 bedroom suite in the heart of Kitsilano. New contemporary kitchen featuring granite counters, stainless steel appliances and Nespresso machine. New contemporary queen bed with 450+thread count sheets and luxurious towels. Lovely living room with high end leather Natuzzi sofa and ottoman, gas fireplace and 46 "flat screen TV. Craftsman style features like cut glass windows, hardwood floors throughout and plush area rugs. Laundry facilities in building. private parking. Free WIFI. Free cable TV.    All utilities included. Centrally located, 2 blocks from Kits Beach, 1 minute to bus stop, 8 minutes to downtown, 10 minutes to UBC. Park with tennis courts and children's play park opposite. Rentals by month, 3 month minimum.

2 blocks from the beach, on a designated bike path, shops and restaurants all within walking distance.  Fantastic walking area in the famous Kitsilano area.


NOTE:   Our Vancouver furnished apartments are located in a modernized character home with a touch of 1912 class just 2 blocks from the ocean.

Many of our guests, who book our furnished suites in Vancouver, include visiting professors at UBC, doctors here for sabbatical and exchange programs at Vancouver General Hospital (VGH), St. Paul’s and UBC hospital, business people here for extended contracts, parents of university students living in student accommodation, parents of children about to have their first baby, wedding guests, pre and post cruise guests, returning Vancouver residents, new immigrants, people undergoing renovations or insurance claims, patients and their families under going medical treatment…..and vacationers of all ages.

Come stay with us at Alma Beach Suites, your home away from home! We look forward to making your stay with us a memorable one as you explore beautiful Vancouver!
